The paper evaluates machine translation outputs by predicting quality scores in reference-only (REF), source-only (SRC), and source-reference-combined (SRC+REF) settings using a unified model.

quote: Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of UniTE. Compared to various strong baseline systems on each task, UniTE, which unifies REF , SRC and SRC+REF tasks into one single model, achieves consistently absolute improvements of Kendall's τ correlations at 1.1, 2.3 and 1.1 scores on English-targeted translation directions of WMT 2019 Metric Shared task , respectively.

We evaluate our methods on all of REF, SRC and SRC+REF scenarios. The official variant of Kendall's Tau correlation is used for evaluation. We compare against baselines such as BLEU, ChrF, YiSi-1, BERTScore, BLEURT, PRISM-ref, BARTScore, XLM‑R+Concat, RoBERTa+Concat, YiSi‑2, PRISM‑src, MTransQuest and COMET.
